full_judgment: 2. The short fact is that the respondent No.1 as pre-emptor filed pre-emption Miscellaneous Case No. 3 of 1996 under section 96 of the state Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 in the court of Assistant Judge, Rajapur, Jhalakathi for pre-emption of 0.14 acres of land out of 2.66 acres described in S.A. khatian No.407 claiming him as a co- sharer by inheritance and purchase stating that the pre-emptee petitioner is a stranger to the khatian under pre-emption.
